_comment: A lord's commission (docs/LIVING_WORLD_2.md §8): weight 0, so no board posts it; offered by rank in the lord's or steward's conversation and bound to the domain's real state by the 'commission' block (quest/commission/Binder).

objectives.label: Take {name} in his lordship's woods by night

title: The poacher
Snares in the lord's woods
A thief of game
summary: Someone sets snares in his lordship's woods, {distance} {direction} of {settlement}. Take the poacher by night and bring them in.
The lord's deer go missing and the snares are fresh. Catch the poacher at it, after dark.
A poacher works his lordship's game, {direction} of here. Take them alive.
offer: His lordship's game is his lordship's. Somebody disagrees, and sets snares at night, {distance} {direction}. Catch them at it.
Snares in the woods, guts by the stream. A poacher. Take them by night, alive if you can.
The keeper found snares again. I want the one who sets them. Bring them to the court.
complete: Taken. The court will see them, and the deer will thank you.
So that was the poacher. Well done.
The woods are his lordship's again.
